Subject: Project assignment & reviewer schedule — Backend Engineer IC4

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the interview loop for Backend Engineer (IC4). As discussed, we use a short take-home project to evaluate system design, API modeling, and a small coding task. Please find the prompt attached (project_instructions.pdf).

High level:
- Deliverables: design doc (1–2 pages), a short API spec (OpenAPI or markdown), and a small code repo or single-file implementation with tests.
- Format: zip or a shared Drive link containing the items above.
- Deadline: Monday, Feb 22, 2026 by 11:59 PM PT. If you need a brief extension, ask ASAP.
- Submission: reply to this thread with the Drive link or attach the zip.

Reviewer plan (we're looping in the review panel):
- Architecture & design: Karthik
- Code review & tests: Dylan
- Behavioral/context & fit discussion: Monica
We plan a 60-minute internal read + debrief on Tue, Feb 23. Proposed window 10:00–11:00 AM PT. I'll send a calendar invite after you confirm the submission.

If anything in the prompt is unclear, ask here — we want to make sure you have a fair chance.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Hiring Manager, Platform Services
Redwood Inference

Attachment: project_instructions.pdf (16 KB)

2) For the API spec, do you prefer OpenAPI YAML or a short markdown table?

If I need a short extension I might ask tomorrow (travel this weekend). Will confirm.

— Alex

I also want to offer a one-day extension due to your travel: new deadline is Wed, Feb 24, 2026 by 5:00 PM PT if you need it. Please let me know which deadline you'll aim for.
